scope: Online password verification across official OpenWrt systems and hardware identities; read-only review, no live authentication or runtime changes.

system_scope.new_wireless_contract: 25.12 uses deployed wifi-scripts files/lib/netifd/wireless.uc and wireless-device.uc; status still exposes interfaces list, section and ifname. The missing old wireless.c is a layout change, not evidence of incompatibility.

hardware_scope.qualification: Reuses the preceding boundary identity audit only; it does not certify online password verification on any model. Q30 is not Q30 Pro. This function uses station/client mode, not PIN monitor/injection acceptance.

findings.problem: The preflight gate accepts WPA3+SAE when WPA appears in the label, enterprise MGT, WEP and WPA1-only labels. Execution always sets UCI psk2 / native WPA-PSK plus RSN, so admission and implemented security support disagree.
findings.recommendation: Reject unsupported or ambiguous security types before radio preparation; do not extend authentication protocols as part of a compatibility guard.

findings.problem: Restore removes owned sections, restores selected interface flags, commits and reloads; success is currently inferred from command completion without full subsequent UCI/runtime readback.
findings.qualification: No evidence here proves this caused an actual router restoration failure.
findings.recommendation: Validate owned temporary sections are gone and original selected-radio flags are restored; distinguish saved configuration from runtime recovery.

findings.problem: Compatibility fallback requires stable IPv4. DHCP failure or IPv6-only operation can remain unconfirmed even when wireless authentication succeeded.
findings.current_protection: Unconfirmed outcomes are not labelled wrong password and are not permanently skipped as confirmed rejection.
findings.qualification: This is not a new root cause proved for the supplied router.

shared_paths_reviewed: exact firmware/component and package architecture selection
actual radio ownership instead of radio numbering
native PONG/status framing and optional pipe/PTY support
native unavailable fallback before submitting candidates only
uncertain status, target timeout, cancellation and scoped restoration

validation.skip_reason: POSIX shell batch execution requires Debian; current host is Windows.

limitations: No claim of complete compatibility across every supported release/model pair.
No real device benchmark, station authentication or restoration check performed.
Historical daemon-control reachability failures remain unresolved by this documentary audit.
